description: This file defines the SecurityPolicy class in the Twig Sandbox component, enforcing security rules for allowed tags, filters, methods, properties, and functions in sandboxed Twig templates.

classes.name: SecurityPolicy
classes.description: Implements a security policy enforcing allowed tags, filters, methods, properties, and functions in Twig sandbox mode.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the security policy with optional lists of allowed tags, filters, methods, properties, and functions.

methods.name: setAllowedTags
methods.description: Sets the list of allowed tags.

methods.name: setAllowedFilters
methods.description: Sets the list of allowed filters.

methods.name: checkSecurity
methods.description: Checks if the given tags, filters, and functions are allowed; throws exceptions if not.

methods.name: checkMethodAllowed
methods.description: Verifies if a method call on an object is permitted according to the policy.

methods.name: checkPropertyAllowed
methods.description: Verifies if a property access on an object is permitted according to the policy.
